messages:
Maria P: Hey team — quick sync: partners want a single reference arch + Terraform modules we can point to in the AWS/GCP marketplace listings. Can we confirm what lives where and who owns the modules?

Ajay K: I can own the TF modules repo. Current plan: one module per cloud (aws, gcp, azure) + a top-level refarch that composes them. Need to decide if we publish modules to the Terraform Registry or keep them in our GH packages.

Sophi L: Link to the draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refarch/pull/42 — includes aws/marketplace.tf and gcp/marketplace.tf templates. Note: AWS needs an AMI build step and an ECR image for the marketplace listing.

Kevin R: For AWS marketplace we also need the listing artifact (CloudFormation/AMI) and a partner onboarding checklist. Who can validate IAM cross-account roles for marketplace SAAS?

Ajay K: I can add cross-account role example. Suggest outputs: module.ecr_repository_url, module.ami_id, module.marketplace_role_arn. Example snippet we should include in README:```hcl\nmodule "redwood_inference" {\n  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refarch//aws?ref=v0.3.0"\n  instance_type = "g5.xlarge"\n  marketplace_role_name = "redwood-marketplace-role"\n}\n```

Jenna T: Quick ops note — if we publish to the public Terraform Registry we need semver tags and stable examples. If we host in our GH org consumers need a token. For partners (commercial marketplaces) registry is nicer for adoption.

Maria P: How about a hybrid: publish stable releases to the public registry; keep in-repo examples and AMI build scripts in partner-refarch repo. Partner PMs can link to registry + repo. Timeline: partner kickoff in 2 weeks.

Sophi L: +1. I'll add a checklist to the PR: AMI bake, ECR image, terraform registry metadata, example deploy (1-click), docs for private marketplace listing flow.

Kevin R: Can someone run a smoke deploy for GCP marketplace? Need sample project and service account to validate IAM scopes.

Ajay K: I'll spin up a test project this afternoon and run the `examples/gcp` config. Will post the terraform plan output.

deploy-bot: CI passed for branch partner-refarch/v0.3.0 — tests: unit, tf-format, example-deploy (aws,gcp) :white_check_mark:

Jenna T: For release we should include a one-pager for partner enablement (what to expect, required artifacts, timeline). I can draft if folks assign owners.

Maria P: Owners: Ajay -> TF modules + cross-account role, Sophi -> AMI/ECR + PR docs, Jenna -> enablement one-pager, Kevin -> marketplace IAM validation. Can we have a signoff checkpoint next Tue 11am PT?

Ajay K: Confirmed. I'll upload a release candidate tag v0.3.0 and ping here when done.

Sophi L: I'll add the bake scripts and the sample cloudbuild config for GCP.

Kevin R: I'll coordinate with partner security to validate roles.

Maria P: Thanks — please drop any consumer-facing demos into `examples/marketplace` so field can test. :thumbsup:
